name: Cable Triceps Extension (Low Pulley)
description: A triceps pushdown or extension variation using a low pulley, requiring the arms to push downward at an angle. The low cable angle creates a different line of pull than high cables, emphasizing the triceps from the stretch position throughout the movement.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Cable Triceps Extension (Low Pulley) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Cable Triceps Extension (Low Pulley).
steps: Step 1: Attach handle to low cable. Stand close facing the pulley.
Step 2: Bend forward at hips and grip handle at chest level.
Step 3: Push handle down and back by extending elbows.
Step 4: Return to bent start position with control.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Feel the tension from the lower pull angle
